summary: Context-only shadow deliberation: the current state is MIXED, not an all-clear. The confirmed Q2/Reflation label is transitioning and no longer supported by its own raw axes, which currently indicate Q1; meanwhile rates/inflation stress remains dominant at 91, credit stress is 83, breadth is weak, and cross-asset confirmation diverges. Market confirmation and normalizing volatility temper the risk read, but the radar's own measured caution-state 21-session pullback rate is below base, so it is an early context flag rather than a demonstrated edge. Liquidity quantity and quality disagree: the overlay is expanding, yet the quality state is stress-expansion, stress is confirming, and the RRP buffer is exhausted. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no active Pair G records, no surviving scorecard factors, and no factor attention authority. Six shadow attention items were recorded with falsifiable closure criteria. One hypothesis was registered for 2026-10-30 testing whether stress-expansion liquidity produces weaker 21-session SPY excess returns than benign expansion; it is proposal material only.
